summary.text: On Dominaria, Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion during her duel with Ravidel so he will not take them.
At the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, Ravidel nonetheless uses Mox Jet, Mox Ruby and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.
Elsewhere, Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm and drives Serra away, and Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.
